+// Validate performs validation on the consistent hash component.
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	var errs []error
+	for _, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+		if err := hp.Validate(); err != nil {
+			errs = append(errs, err)
+			continue
+		}
+		if regex := hp.GetHeader().GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern().GetRegex(); regex != "" {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(regex); err != nil {
+				errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("invalid consistentHash header regexRewrite pattern: %w", err))
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return errors.Join(errs...)
+}
+
+// constructConsistentHash constructs the consistent hash policy IR from the policy specification.
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ch == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if ptr.Deref(ch.Disable, false) {
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{disable: true}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var errs []error
+	hashPolicies := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0,
+		len(ch.Headers)+len(ch.Cookies)+len(ch.QueryParameters)+len(ch.FilterState)+1)
+
+	for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+		header := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			header.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{Header: header},
+			Terminal:        ptr.Deref(h.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+		cookie := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+			Path: ptr.Deref(c.Path, ""),
+		}
+		if c.TTL != nil {
+			ttl, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL)
+			if err != nil {
+				errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("invalid consistentHash cookie %q ttl: %w", c.Name, err))
+				continue
+			}
+			cookie.Ttl = durationpb.New(ttl)
+		}
+		for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+			cookie.Attributes = append(cookie.Attributes, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+				Name:  attr.Name,
+				Value: attr.Value,
+			})
+		}
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{Cookie: cookie},
+			Terminal:        ptr.Deref(c.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, q := range ch.QueryParameters {
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: q.Name,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(q.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, f := range ch.FilterState {
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: f.Key,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(f.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	sourceIP := ch.SourceIP
+	if sourceIP == nil && len(ch.Headers) == 0 && len(ch.Cookies) == 0 &&
+		len(ch.QueryParameters) == 0 && len(ch.FilterState) == 0 {
+		// default to hashing on the source IP when no hash sources are specified
+		sourceIP = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{}
+	}
+	if sourceIP != nil {
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, newSourceIPHashPolicy(ptr.Deref(sourceIP.Terminal, false)))
+	}
+
+	if len(errs) > 0 {
+		return errors.Join(errs...)
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies: dedupAndSortHashPolicies(hashPolicies),
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+func newSourceIPHashPolicy(terminal bool) *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	return &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+		PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+			ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+				SourceIp: true,
+			},
+		},
+		Terminal: terminal,
+	}
+}
+
+// parseCookieTTL parses a cookie TTL expressed either as a Go duration string (e.g. "1h30m")
+// or as an integer number of seconds (e.g. "3600").
+func parseCookieTTL(s string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("must not be negative: %s", s)
+		}
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(s)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	if d < 0 {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("must not be negative: %s", s)
+	}
+	return d, nil
+}
+
+// hashPolicyTypeRank returns the canonical order of the given hash policy's type.
+func hashPolicyTypeRank(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) int {
+	switch hp.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+		return 0
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+		return 1
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+		return 2
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+		return 3
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_:
+		return 4
+	default:
+		return 5
+	}
+}
+
+// hashPolicyKey returns the identifying key of the given hash policy used for deduplication.
+func hashPolicyKey(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+	switch spec := hp.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+		// HTTP header names are case-insensitive
+		return "header/" + strings.ToLower(spec.Header.GetHeaderName())
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+		return "cookie/" + spec.Cookie.GetName()
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+		return "queryParameter/" + spec.QueryParameter.GetName()
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+		return "filterState/" + spec.FilterState.GetKey()
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_:
+		return "sourceIp"
+	default:
+		return fmt.Sprintf("unknown/%p", hp)
+	}
+}
+
+// dedupAndSortHashPolicies returns a new slice with the given hash policies deduplicated by
+// their identifying key (first occurrence wins) and stably sorted into canonical type order.
+func dedupAndSortHashPolicies(in []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(in))
+	out := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(in))
+	for _, hp := range in {
+		key := hashPolicyKey(hp)
+		if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[key] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, hp)
+	}
+	slices.SortStableFunc(out, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) int {
+		return hashPolicyTypeRank(a) - hashPolicyTypeRank(b)
+	})
+	return out
+}
+
+// unionConsistentHash unions the hash policies of the higher priority policy (hi) and the lower
+// priority policy (lo), giving precedence to hi's entries. The sourceIp scalar is always taken
+// from hi, even when unset. If hi is disabled, hi is returned as is; a disabled lo contributes nothing.
+func unionConsistentHash(hi, lo *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	if hi.disable {
+		return hi
+	}
+	combined := slices.Clone(hi.hashPolicies)
+	if !lo.disable {
+		for _, hp := range lo.hashPolicies {
+			if hp.GetConnectionProperties() != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			combined = append(combined, hp)
+		}
+	}
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies: dedupAndSortHashPolicies(combined),
+	}
+}
+
+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	p2Field := p2.spec.consistentHash
+	if p2Field == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	p1Field := p1.spec.consistentHash
+	if p1Field == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = p2Field
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne(consistentHashMergeField, p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	switch opts.Strategy {
+	case policy.AugmentedShallowMerge, policy.AugmentedDeepMerge:
+		// p1 has higher priority
+		merged := unionConsistentHash(p1Field, p2Field)
+		if merged.Equals(p1Field) {
+			return
+		}
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = merged
+		mergeOrigins.Append(consistentHashMergeField, p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+
+	case policy.OverridableDeepMerge:
+		// p2 has higher priority
+		merged := unionConsistentHash(p2Field, p1Field)
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = merged
+		if merged.Equals(p2Field) {
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne(consistentHashMergeField, p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		} else {
+			mergeOrigins.Append(consistentHashMergeField, p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		}
+
+	case policy.OverridableShallowMerge:
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = p2Field
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne(consistentHashMergeField, p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+
+	default:
+		logger.Warn("unsupported merge strategy for policy", "strategy", opts.Strategy, "policy", p2Ref, "field", consistentHashMergeField)
+	}
+}
+
+// applyConsistentHash applies the consistent hash configuration to the Envoy route action.
+func applyConsistentHash(consistentHash *consistentHashIR, action *envoyroutev3.RouteAction) {
+	if consistentHash == nil || action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if consistentHash.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = consistentHash.hashPolicies
+}
